paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev.
model_annotation: This bar chart presents the execution accuracy of four different logical synthesis modules – Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total – when applied to the BIRD-dev dataset. The horizontal axis represents the module names, listed alphabetically from left to right: Challenging, Moderate, Simple, and Total. The vertical axis, labeled “Execution Accuracy,” ranges from 30 to 60 and utilizes a linear scale. The values on the vertical axis are displayed in increments of 5, with tick labels indicating accuracies of 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, and 60. The bar for “Simple” is colored blue and reaches a height of approximately 48.60, while the bar for “Moderate” is colored teal and reaches a height of 60.21. The “Challenging” bar is colored light blue and measures approximately 39.64, the “Total” bar is colored blue and reaches a height of 56.19, and the “Moderate” bar is colored teal and measures 51.35. The “TA-SQL” bar, appearing in shades of blue, corresponds to the “Total” module and reaches a height of 36.11, while the “NatSQL” bar, in shades of blue, corresponds to the “Total” module and reaches a height of 63.14.  The bars are not sorted in any particular order.
